description: RGB domain 0x10 version 7 golden vectors for firmware and Charybdis Ark (D-F14): version 6 with a locality for each feedback case (D-F73). A tap-branch colour is four bytes, h s v and a locality of 0 to 4; the behaviour feedback record is thirteen bytes, the three tier colours and the tap-commit policy where they were (bytes 0-9), then the tap committed, hold and long hold localities (10-12); the replacement feedback record is sixteen bytes, the text, macro, undo and leading colours (0-11), then a locality for each in the same order (12-15). Behaviour-feedback group rows take semantic 0 (the tap branch pending for tap count 2), 1 tap committed, 2 hold, 3 long hold, 4, 5 and 6 (the tap branch pending for tap counts 3, 4 and 5 or more), 7 (any tap branch pending, D-F75) or 0xFF all. Stage bit 5 is the replacement feedback stage (D-F70); header byte 14 counts its group rows and byte 15 stays reserved. The 640 group rows in all count five tables. Derived from the version 6 vectors by setting the version and giving every new locality the old one of its stage; offsets past each inserted byte move with it. The vectors named replacement-*, key-* and those ending -with-replacement are built on 'compiled'. 'compiled' is the firmware's compiled RGB domain. Error codes are the firmware's NOAH_PROFILE_RGB_V1_* names; offsets are payload-relative. D-F63 raised the ceilings to 128 groups and 640 group rows in all, 255 in one table.
